composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. creative_direction: Show broad golden dunes curving across the lower half beneath pale peach sunrise light. The nearest ridge carries fine wind lines, while distant dunes become smooth quiet bands. Keep the sun itself outside the frame, letting warmth arrive through soft edge highlights. A clear, lightly graded sky opens above, creating renewed calm through simple geometry and restrained texture. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
